review.notes: Full normalized text diff of the OCR markdown against extracted text from all 25 physical PDF pages; physical pages 3, 6 and 21 were rendered (120 dpi) and visually inspected to confirm the section III heading style, the footnote 1 body and the reference [106] author list. The only code fence pair (lines 115-118) is balanced; no swallowed blocks. All other unmatched PDF lines are figure-internal text (title-page graphics, Fig. 6/10/11/13 prompts, Fig. 17-19 labels, p22-23 axis labels) that the embedded figure images already show. Reference page numbers trailing entries (e.g. '3', '7, 22') are the PDF's own margin citation back-references and were kept.
